background.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: 16:9 visual-novel background for The Alchemist. Create an empty Tangier marketplace in Morocco, period-neutral old port city: whitewashed buildings, modest arched doorways, closed wooden market stalls at the edges, a narrow steep street visible rising between buildings at the right, distant slender minaret. Warm late-afternoon amber light, teal shadows, clean dark slate outlines, restrained flat cel-shaded graphic-novel style. Broad unobstructed foreground for two animated characters; eye-level view. No people, no animals, no text or lettering, no logos or watermark, no modern objects. Place furniture only near back and edges. Subtle lived-in atmosphere, neither exotic fantasy nor photorealism.

teaser.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a wide 16:9 cinematic graphic-novel still for a teaser adapting The Alchemist. In the same Tangier marketplace as the reference, now almost empty at dusk, Santiago, a slim teenage Andalusian shepherd with warm tan skin, tousled short brown hair, keen brown eyes, a simple ochre-brown tunic with muted olive trim and dark trousers, stands alone at centre-left. Medium shot from the waist up. He looks down anxiously into a small open leather pouch held in both hands, realizing his money is gone. His shoulders have lost their confidence, his mouth closed; make the vulnerability quiet and believable. The pouch and his hands are clearly visible. Keep the marketplace recognisable. Clean dark outlines, cel-shaded graphic novel animation, restrained warm amber and teal palette, expressive face, no photorealism, no text, no captions, no watermarks, no other people. This is Santiago, not a modern school student.
